newsitem.title: UK: Banco Excel Economico adds $25 mln to 8-year bond.
newsitem.headline: Banco Excel Economico adds $25 mln to 8-year bond.

text.p: Banco Excel Economico SA has added $25 million to its $150 million eight-year bond, lead manager Indosuez Capital said on Thursday.
The deal was launched Wednesday. All other terms remain the same. There is a 10.75 percent coupon and 97.52 issue price.
The reoffer spread was 498 basis points over U.S. Treasuries. Calls and puts after three and five years were also priced to give a 498 b.p. spread.
The deal will be listed in Luxembourg.
The bank was formed earlier this year after Banco Excel acquired the assets of failed bank Banco Economico SA BCE.SA.
